description.zh:
认证类型，默认不填，只有支持号码认证时可多选，以英文逗号间隔。

- **1**：号码认证。

- **2**：短信认证。
description.en:
Authentication type. Optional. Select multiple values only if number authentication is supported. Separate multiple values with commas.

- **1**: Number authentication.

- **2**: Text message authentication.

description.zh: BundleID，osType为iOS时必填。由数字、字母、短划线（-）、下划线或点组成，长度限制为1~128个字符。
description.en: Bundle ID. Required when OsType is iOS. Must contain only digits, letters, hyphens (-), underscores, or periods. Length: 1 to 128 characters.

description.zh: 中国移动通道Code，默认可不填。
中国电信通道Code，默认可不填。
中国联通通道Code，默认可不填。
密钥获取接收邮箱地址，默认可不填。
description.en: Email address to receive the key. Optional.

description.zh: AppId，osType为`Harmony`时必填。长度为19位纯数字。
description.en: App ID. Required when OsType is `Harmony`. Length: 19 digits.

description.zh: 包名，osType为`Harmony`时必填。由数字、字母、下划线或点组成.必须以字母开头，长度限制为7~127个字符。
description.en: Package name. Required when OsType is `Harmony`. Must contain only digits, letters, underscores, or periods. Must start with a letter. Length: 7 to 127 characters.

description.zh: 包签名，osType为`Harmony`时必填。由数字和字母组成，长度为64个字符。
description.en: Package signature. Required when OsType is `Harmony`. Must contain only digits and letters. Length: 64 characters.

description.zh: H5方案页面源地址（建议填写域名级别）。
description.en: Source URL of the H5 scheme page. We recommend specifying the domain level.

description.zh:
终端操作系统类型，取值：

- iOS
- Android
- Harmony
- Web
description.en:
Operating system type of the client. Valid values:

- iOS

- Android

- Harmony

- Web

description.zh: 包名，osType为Android时必填。由数字、字母、短划线（-）、下划线或点组成，长度限制为1~128个字符。
description.en: Package name. Required when OsType is Android. Must contain only digits, letters, hyphens (-), underscores, or periods. Length: 1 to 128 characters.

description.zh: 包签名，osType为Android时必填。由数字和字母组成，长度为32个字符。
description.en: Package signature. Required when OsType is Android. Must contain only digits and letters. Length: 32 characters.

description.zh: 绑定的短信签名，只有AuthType包含2（短信认证）时才有效，且签名必须是号码认证产品下创建的已经审核通过的。
description.en: Bound text message signature. Valid only if AuthType includes 2 (text message authentication). The signature must be approved and created under the number authentication product.
Page URL used by the H5 scheme.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

This API supports up to 100 calls per second per user. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Use this API carefully.
